label: Zwembad
analysis_hint: Recommend an inground swimming pool strictly in the backyard. Estimate the usable backyard width and length in metres to help select the right pool model. Note whether the garden is compact/urban or large/suburban.
edit_prompt:
Add a photorealistic Aquapura inground swimming pool in authentic Belgian premium style. The pool is the hero — make it the clear focal point of the image. Follow these visual rules precisely:

WATER: crystal-clear light blue-green water, highly reflective, no murky or tropical blue tones.

COPING & SURROUND: dark grey Belgian bluestone or anthracite natural stone coping tiles flush with the pool edge on all sides. The surrounding terrace is large flat grey stone slabs (not beige, not warm-toned).

ROLLUWANDECK: an anthracite-grey automatic rolling cover (rolluik) partially retracted at one short end of the pool, sitting low and flush with the coping level.

FURNITURE: two or three low minimalist sun loungers in white or light grey on the terrace directly beside the pool.

SHAPE: strictly rectangular or square — clean geometric edges, no organic or freeform shapes.

STYLE: high-end Belgian premium pool product — minimal, refined, northern European. Keep the background neutral and unobtrusive. Absolutely no tropical, Mediterranean, or holiday-resort elements.
video_prompt: Sparkling crystal-clear light blue-green pool water with gentle ripples, dark grey Belgian bluestone coping, anthracite rolling cover partially retracted, warm golden-hour lighting over a manicured Belgian garden.
